# California State Board of Pharmacy

> The official regulatory body overseeing pharmacy licensing, consumer protection, and disciplinary enforcement in California.

The California State Board of Pharmacy is a regulatory agency under the Department of Consumer Affairs that manages licensing for pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, and pharmacy facilities, while also protecting consumers through complaint investigation and enforcement actions. The Board provides comprehensive guidance on medication safety, prescription drug abuse prevention, and maintains compliance standards for all pharmacy operations in California.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacy Licensing
- Consumer Protection
- Regulatory Compliance
- License Requirements
- Disciplinary Enforcement
- Complaint Filing
- Medication Safety
- Prescription Drug Abuse Prevention
- Business and Professions Code
- CPJE (California Pharmacist Jurisprudence Examination)
- License Renewal
- Continuing Education
- California Department of Consumer Affairs
- Facility Licensing
- Personal Licensing

## Licensing & Applications

- [Apply for a Personal License](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/applicants/apply_personal.shtml): Application guide for pharmacist and pharmacy technician personal licenses
- [Apply for a Facility License](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/applicants/apply_facility.shtml): Application guide for pharmacy facility and wholesaler licensing
- [Disclosure of Disciplinary Action, Arrest, or Conviction](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/applicants/criminal_convictions.shtml): Licensing requirements and disclosure guidelines for criminal convictions
- [How to Appeal the Denial of a License](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/applicants/appeal_denial.shtml): License denial appeal process and administrative hearing procedures

## Consumer Resources & Safety

- [Information You Need to Know](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/consumers/information.shtml): Consumer guidance on medication safety, disposal, and pharmacy resources
- [Information about Drug Abuse and Treatment](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/consumers/rx_abuse_prevention.shtml): Resources on prescription drug abuse prevention and treatment programs
- [Filing a Complaint](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/consumers/complaint_info.shtml): Consumer complaint filing process and enforcement procedures

## Enforcement & Petitions

- [Petition for Reinstatement, Early Termination of Probation, and Reduction of Penalty](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/enforcement/petitions.shtml): Petition procedures for license reinstatement and penalty modification

## Support & Communication

- [Contact Us](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/about/contact_us.shtml): Contact information, office hours, and complaint filing for Board
- [Board of Pharmacy Email Registration](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/webapplications/apps/subscribe/index.shtml): Email subscription service for pharmacy compliance alerts and notifications
- [Request a Publication or Fingerprint Cards](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/webapplications/apps/pub_request/index.shtml): Form submission for publications and fingerprint card requests

## Optional

- [Accessibility](https://pharmacy.ca.gov/accessibility.shtml): Web accessibility standards compliance and disability support information
